Title: Estimate model averages as-printed and annealed HDT of one grade as repeats
Evidence: build/src/estimates.js rawObservations groups by material|formulation|kind and kindOf() never reads postProcessing. dist/db.json meta.estimateModel.conflicts: M068 'HDT 0.45' [V001931 81.6, V001933 133.7]; M019 'HDT 0.45' [V000350 75.5, V000353 114.7] and 'HDT 1.8 amorphous' [V000349 59.7, V000352 84]; M074 'HDT 0.45' [V002071 236.3, V002072 248.9] and 'HDT 1.8 semi-filled' [V001392 125.8, V002073 219.6]. Sources re-read (hash-ok): R-FIBERON-PETGF15-TDS p1 'ISO 75 0.45MPa 133.7°C (annealed)' / 'ISO 75 0.45MPa 81.6 (as printed)'; S-POLYCN-Polymaker-HT-PLA-GF-TDS-EN-V1-1 p3 'ISO 75 0.45MPa 75.5°C (as printed)' / '114.7°C (annealed)'; S-FIBER-PPSGF-TDS-2 p1 '*The HDT test specimens were annealed by 130°C. If the annealing temperature is increased to 230°C, the HDT (0.45MPa/1.8MPa) is increased to 248.9°C/219.6°C.' All six groups are caught by the conflict check (noise x25), so the formulation's own HDT evidence is effectively discarded rather than modelled.
